Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

on the last line of your reply:

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt cap is reached, and
reaching the cap is charged the full cap. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

# Continual-ARC

1. Parse the grid, caps, and action schema. Treat each instance as independent and use only its demonstrations. Infer output dimensions and a complete mapping that accounts for object roles, boundaries, direction, extent, and collisions; check it against every demo. For periodic/diagonal patterns, derive an explicit coordinate rule (including modulus, orientation, and phase), then verify a small coordinate table across successive rows and columns before filling the grid. Do not extrapolate a generic mirror, ray, fill, or tiling from resemblance alone. After an incorrect submission, reassess the entire rule against all demonstrations and identify the unsupported assumption before acting again. Do not cycle through guessed recolorings or submit an altered version of a failed candidate without evidence that distinguishes it.
3. Request a demo only when you can name at least two plausible rule alternatives and state what differing outcome the requested pair would predict; weigh that information against the demo cost. After receiving it, explicitly eliminate or retain alternatives. Do not spend another demo unless a new, specific distinction remains, and do not request one when existing examples establish a consistent rule. If the rule remains underdetermined, prefer a discriminating demo to an unsupported full-grid guess when its expected value justifies the cost.
4. Before every action, check its cost and remaining cap. For submission, validate the entire grid's dimensions and values, and put exactly one action JSON on the final line. Request demos using their exact action; use finish only after the instance is over.
